title: I have been in China for three years
simplified_paragraphs: 我来中国学习和工作三年了。五年前，我第一次来中国旅游，爱上了这里吃的东西。回国后，我开始在网上学习汉语，一开始自己学习，后来又在网上找了一位汉语老师帮助我。我考过了HSK4级考试以后，就想来中国继续学习。到了中国以后，我先在北京学习汉语，后来找到了上海的工作，就来上海生活了。三年了，我越来越了解中国文化，也交了很多中国朋友。我想明年去广东工作。广东是个暖和的地方，还有很多好吃的东西，我应该会很快乐。
traditional_paragraphs: 我來中國學習和工作三年了。五年前，我第一次來中國旅遊，愛上了這裡吃的東西。回國後，我開始在網上學習漢語，一開始自己學習，後來又在網上找了一位漢語老師幫助我。我考過了HSK4級考試以後，就想來中國繼續學習。到了中國以後，我先在北京學習漢語，後來找到了上海的工作，就來上海生活了。三年了，我越來越瞭解中國文化，也交了很多中國朋友。我想明年去廣東工作。廣東是個暖和的地方，還有很多好吃的東西，我應該會很快樂。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ lái Zhōng guó xué xí hé gōng zuò sān nián le。 wǔ nián qián， wǒ dì yī cì lái Zhōng guó lǚ yóu， ài shàng le zhè lǐ chī de dōng xi。 huí guó hòu， wǒ kāi shǐ zài wǎng shang xué xí Hàn yǔ， yī kāi shǐ zì jǐ xué xí， hòu lái yòu zài wǎng shang zhǎo le yī wèi Hàn yǔ lǎo shī bāng zhù wǒ。 wǒ kǎo guo le HSK4 jí kǎo shì yǐ hòu， jiù xiǎng lái Zhōng guó jì xù xué xí。 dào le Zhōng guó yǐ hòu， wǒ xiān zài Běi jīng xué xí Hàn yǔ， hòu lái zhǎo dào le Shàng hǎi de gōng zuò， jiù lái Shàng hǎi shēng huó le。 sān nián le， wǒ yuè lái yuè liǎo jiě Zhōng guó wén huà， yě jiāo le hěn duō Zhōng guó péng you。 wǒ xiǎng míng nián qù Guǎng dōng gōng zuò。 Guǎng dōng shì gè nuǎn huo de dì fang， hái yǒu hěn duō hǎo chī de dōng xi， wǒ yīng gāi huì hěn kuài lè。
english_paragraphs: I have been studying and working in China for three years. Five years ago, I traveled to China for the first time and fell in love with the food here. After returning to China, I started learning Chinese online. At first I studied by myself, and later I found a Chinese teacher online to help me. After I passed the HSK Level 4 exam, I wanted to come to China to continue my studies. After arriving in China, I first studied Chinese in Beijing, then found a job in Shanghai and came to live in Shanghai. Over the past three years, I have learned more about Chinese culture and made many Chinese friends. I want to work in Guangdong next year. Guangdong is a warm place with a lot of delicious food. I should be very happy.
english_full: I have been studying and working in China for three years. Five years ago, I traveled to China for the first time and fell in love with the food here. After returning to China, I started learning Chinese online. At first I studied by myself, and later I found a Chinese teacher online to help me. After I passed the HSK Level 4 exam, I wanted to come to China to continue my studies. After arriving in China, I first studied Chinese in Beijing, then found a job in Shanghai and came to live in Shanghai. Over the past three years, I have learned more about Chinese culture and made many Chinese friends. I want to work in Guangdong next year. Guangdong is a warm place with a lot of delicious food. I should be very happy.
